program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 8.0, 20.0),       # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.25, 0.15, 1.0),       # diff pair L
    "I1":    (130e-6, 60e-6, 250e-6), # per-side pair current (tail = 2*I1)
    "Ic":    (100e-6, 40e-6, 200e-6), # cascode branch current
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.25, 2.0),        # PMOS fold current-source L
    "Lc":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),        # cascode L (P and N)
    "Ln":    (0.5, 0.25, 2.0),        # NMOS bottom mirror L
    "gmidb": (11.0, 6.0, 16.0),       # NMOS bias / tail gm/Id
}

def size_for_vgs(lut, dev, L, I, vt, vds=0.6, vsb=0.0):
    best = None
    for g in np.linspace(3.0, 18.0, 61):
        try:
            op = lut.size(dev, float(g), L, I, vds=vds, vsb=vsb)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if best is None or abs(op.vgs - vt) < abs(best.vgs - vt):
            best = op
    return best

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vdd = 1.8
    I1, Ic = p["I1"], p["Ic"]; Isrc = I1 + Ic; Itail = 2 * I1; Ib = 20e-6
    Lb = 0.5

    # bias reference and tail
    mb0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    m0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], Lb, Itail, vds=0.25)
    # diff pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.1, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS fold current sources
    m3 = lut.size("p", 9.0, p["L3"], Isrc, vds=0.35)
    # PMOS cascodes (source at ~vdd-0.35)
    m5 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["Lc"], Ic, vds=0.5, vsb=0.35)
    # NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror
    m9 = lut.size("n", 8.0, p["Ln"], Ic, vds=0.35)
    vds9 = m9.vdsat + 0.15
    m7 = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Lc"], Ic, vds=0.5, vsb=vds9)

    # bias branches
    mb1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], Lb, Ib, vds=0.8)      # sink for vbp diode
    mb2 = lut.size("p", 9.0, p["L3"], Ib, vds=m3.vgs)     # vbp diode (mirror ref of M3)
    mb3 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], Lb, Ib, vds=0.4)      # sink for vbpc diode
    vsg_t = m5.vgs + m3.vdsat + 0.15
    mb4 = size_for_vgs(lut, "p", p["Lc"], Ib, vsg_t, vds=vsg_t)
    mb5 = lut.size("p", 9.0, p["L3"], Ib, vds=0.9)        # source for vbnc diode
    vgs_t = m7.vgs + vds9
    mb6 = size_for_vgs(lut, "n", p["Lc"], Ib, vgs_t, vds=vgs_t)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("M0", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("M1", "f1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "f2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "f1", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "f2", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M5", "nm", "vbpc", "f1", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "vbpc", "f2", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "nm", "vbnc", "s1", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "vbnc", "s2", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M9", "s1", "nm", "vss", "vss", m9)
    n.dev("M10", "s2", "nm", "vss", "vss", m9)
    n.dev("MB1", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MB2", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mb2)
    n.dev("MB3", "vbpc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb3)
    n.dev("MB4", "vbpc", "vbpc", "vdd", "vdd", mb4)
    n.dev("MB5", "vbnc", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mb5)
    n.dev("MB6", "vbnc", "vbnc", "vss", "vss", mb6)

    # performance model
    gds_f = m1.gds + m3.gds
    r_up = (m5.gm + m5.gmbs) / m5.gds / gds_f
    r_dn = (m7.gm + m7.gmbs) / m7.gds / m9.gds
    rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / r_up + 1.0 / r_dn)
    a0 = m1.gm * rout
    cout = cl + m5.cdd + m7.cdd + 2 * m5.cgd
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    cf = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg
    fpf = (m5.gm + m5.gmbs) / (2 * PI * cf)
    cm = 2 * m9.cgg + m7.cdd + m5.cdd
    fpm = m9.gm / (2 * PI * cm)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fpf)) * 1.5 \
            - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fpm))
    power = vdd * (2 * Isrc + 3 * Ib + iref)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": min(Itail, Ic) / cl}
